# Mixed models. *Built to scale.*

OPEN-SOURCE R SOFTWARE

sommer is an R package for advanced mixed models, quantitative genetics,
genomic prediction, G×E analysis, and large-scale statistical computing.

[Explore
sommer](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/index.md)[Work with
me](#services)

Free and open source under GPL-3.

A flexible mixed-model framework

y = Xβ + Zu + e

GRKΣH⊗VAI-REML

From classical mixed models to genomic, multivariate, spatial, and
heterogeneous covariance structures.

WHAT SOMMER DOES

## One framework for complex models.

G

### Quantitative genetics

Variance components, relationship matrices, heritability, BLUPs, and
advanced genetic models.

×

### G×E analysis

Model genotype-by-environment interaction with flexible covariance
structures and heterogeneous variances.

Σ

### Multivariate models

Fit multiple traits and structured covariance relationships within a
unified mixed-model framework.

∾

### Genomic prediction

Work with genomic relationship matrices and modern prediction workflows
in R.

⊥

### Sparse computation

Designed for computationally demanding mixed-model problems where matrix
structure matters.

R

### R-native workflow

Formula-based modeling, familiar R data structures, and an ecosystem
built for reproducible research.

LEARN

## Research software should be understandable.

Explore examples, tutorials, documentation, and the source code. The
project is developed openly so researchers can inspect, reproduce,
extend, and contribute to the methods.

tutorials**&nearr;**](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/articles/index.md)

PROFESSIONAL SERVICES

## Need help with a difficult model?

sommer is free and open source. Professional consulting is available for
organizations that need expert help implementing, optimizing, or
extending advanced mixed-model and quantitative-genetic analyses.

### Advanced mixed models

Model development for multivariate, G×E, spatial, heterogeneous, and
structured covariance problems.

### Performance optimization

Profile and accelerate large mixed-model workflows, sparse computations,
and demanding genomic analyses.

### Custom development

New covariance structures, algorithms, R/C++ functionality, and research
software tailored to a scientific problem.

### Genomic prediction

Design and implement quantitative-genetic and genomic prediction
workflows for research and breeding programs.

### Migration & integration

Help move established mixed-model workflows into reproducible R and
sommer-based pipelines.

### Training & workshops

Practical training in mixed models, quantitative genetics, genomic
prediction, and advanced sommer workflows.

**Have a model that is difficult to fit?**

Tell me about the data, model, computational bottleneck, or method you
need to develop.

[Start a
conversation](mailto:cova_ruber@live.com.mx?subject=sommer%20consulting%20inquiry)

CITATION

## Use sommer in your research?

Please cite the sommer publication associated with the version and
methods you use. See the repository for current citation information and
publications.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`A.mat()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/A.mat.md) :
  Additive relationship matrix

- [`D.mat()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/D.mat.md) :
  Dominance relationship matrix

- [`GWAS()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/DEPRECATED_GWAS.md)
  : Genome wide association study analysis

- [`vs()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/DEPRECATED_VS.md)
  : variance structure specification

- [`vsr()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/DEPRECATED_VSR.md)
  : variance structure specification

- [`summary(`*`<mmer>`*`)`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/DEPRECATED_summary_mmer.md)
  : summary form a GLMM fitted with mmer

- [`E.mat()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/E.mat.md) :
  Epistatic relationship matrix

- [`H.mat()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/H.mat.md) :
  Combined relationship matrix H

- [`MNR()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/MNR.md) :
  Multivariate Newton-Raphson algorithm

- [`anova(`*`<mmes>`*`)`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/anova_mmes.md)
  : anova form a GLMM fitted with mmes

- [`antem()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/antem.md) :
  Antedependence covariance structure

- [`ar1m()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/ar1m.md) :
  First-order autoregressive covariance structure

- [`ar2m()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/ar2m.md) :
  Second-order autoregressive covariance structure

- [`ar3m()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/ar3m.md) :
  Third-order autoregressive covariance structure

- [`atm()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/atm.md) :
  Selected-level diagonal covariance structure

- [`atr()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/atr.md) :

  Selected-level diagonal covariance structure for `mmer` and `vsr`

- [`car()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/car.md) :
  Proper conditional autoregressive spatial covariance structure

- [`coef(`*`<mmes>`*`)`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/coef_mmes.md)
  : coef form a GLMM fitted with mmes

- [`corImputation()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/corImputation.md)
  : Imputing a matrix using correlations

- [`corgm()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/corgm.md) :
  General positive-definite correlation structure

- [`covm()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/covm.md) :
  Covariance Between Two Random Effects

- [`covparams_mmes()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/covparams_mmes.md)
  : Extract native-scale covariance parameters from an mmes fit

- [`covparams_mmes_se()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/covparams_mmes_se.md)
  : Native-scale covariance parameters and standard errors

- [`csm()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/csm.md) :
  Compound-symmetry covariance structure

- [`csr()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/csr.md) :

  User-specified covariance-component structure for `mmer` and `vsr`

- [`dfToMatrix()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/dfToMatrix.md)
  : data frame to matrix

- [`dsm()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/dsm.md) :
  Diagonal heterogeneous covariance structure

- [`dsr()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/dsr.md) :

  Diagonal covariance structure for `mmer` and `vsr`

- [`fam()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/fam.md) :
  Factor-analytic covariance structure

- [`fitted(`*`<mmes>`*`)`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/fitted_mmes.md)
  : fitted form a LMM fitted with mmes

- [`fixm()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/fixm.md) :
  fixed indication matrix

- [`ism()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/ism.md) :
  Identity covariance structure

- [`loadings_mmes()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/loadings_mmes.md)
  : Extract factor-analytic loadings from a fitted mmes model

- [`mam()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/mam.md)
  [`ma1m()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/mam.md)
  [`ma2m()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/mam.md) :
  Moving-average covariance structures of order one or two

- [`maternm()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/maternm.md)
  : Matern spatial covariance structure

- [`mmer()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/mmer.md) :

  **m**ixed **m**odel **e**quations for **r** records

- [`mmes()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/mmes.md) :

  **m**ixed **m**odel **e**quations **s**olver

- [`ownm()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/ownm.md) :
  User-defined covariance structure

- [`pmonitor()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/plot.monitor.md)
  : plot the change of VC across iterations

- [`plot(`*`<mmes>`*`)`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/plot_mmes.md)
  : plot form a LMM plot with mmes

- [`postPEV()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/postPEV.md)
  : Post-fit prediction error variances and inverse coefficient matrix

- [`predict(`*`<mmes>`*`)`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/predict_mmes.md)
  : Predict form of a LMM fitted with mmes

- [`r2()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/r2.md) :
  Reliability

- [`randef()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/randef.md) :
  extracting random effects

- [`residuals(`*`<mmes>`*`)`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/residuals_mmes.md)
  : Residuals form a GLMM fitted with mmes

- [`rotate_back_mmes()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/rotate_back_mmes.md)
  : Back-transform rotated mmes random effects

- [`rrcm()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/rrcm.md) :
  Reduced-rank covariance structure

- [`sar()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/sar.md) :
  Simultaneous autoregressive spatial covariance structure

- [`scores_mmes()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/scores_mmes.md)
  : Predict factor-analytic scores from a fitted mmes model

- [`sommer`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/sommer-package.md)
  :

  **So**lving **M**ixed **M**odel **E**quations in **R**  
  ![Figure: mai.png](figures/mai.png)

- [`spl2Dc()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/spl2Dc.md) :
  Two-dimensional penalised tensor-product of marginal B-Spline basis.

- [`spl2Dmats()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/spl2Dmats.md)
  : Get Tensor Product Spline Mixed Model Incidence Matrices

- [`summary(`*`<mmes>`*`)`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/summary_mmes.md)
  : summary form a GLMM fitted with mmes

- [`toeplitzm()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/toeplitzm.md)
  : General positive-definite Toeplitz correlation structure

- [`tpsmmbwrapper()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/tpsmmbwrapper.md)
  : Get Tensor Product Spline Mixed Model Incidence Matrices

- [`unsm()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/unsm.md) :
  unstructured indication matrix

- [`usm()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/usm.md) :
  Unstructured positive-definite covariance structure

- [`usr()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/usr.md) :

  Unstructured covariance structure for `mmer` and `vsr`

- [`vpredict()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/vpredict.md)
  : vpredict form of a LMM fitted with mmes

- [`vsm()`](https://covaruber.github.io/sommer/reference/vsm.md) :
  Variance-structure model with arbitrary Kronecker covariance factors
